en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a domed Ottoman‑style building with a tall, slender minaret rising in front of adjoining houses and a garden with benches in the foreground. In the upper part of the image there is red printed text reading "Pécs" on the left and "Török minaret" on the right. The reverse side has a divided back with printed Hungarian text, a circular postmark, handwritten message and address.
